# Logs: reference

gash logs: find the log files that fill a disk and reclaim the space safely. The guide is [README.md](README.md); this page lists every function, alias and command, as their own help prints it (`gash_help NAME`, `gash COMMAND --help`).

## Commands

### gash logs

```text
Find and reclaim disk space from log files

Usage:
  gash logs [flags]
  gash logs [command]

Available Commands:
  clean       Reclaim space: delete rotated logs, optionally truncate live ones
  scan        Report the log files eating disk, grouped by category

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for logs

Use "gash logs [command] --help" for more information about a command.
```

### gash logs clean

```text
Reclaim space: delete rotated logs, optionally truncate live ones

Usage:
  gash logs clean [PATH...] [flags]

Flags:
      --depth int           limit how deep each root is walked (0: no limit)
      --dry-run             show what would be freed, change nothing
  -h, --help                help for clean
      --json                one JSON object on stdout
      --min-size string     ignore files smaller than this (e.g. 1M, 512K)
      --older-than string   ignore files modified more recently than this (e.g. 7d, 48h)
      --sudo                reclaim root-owned logs too, with one sudo
      --truncate            also truncate live logs in place (keeps the file for running daemons)
  -y, --yes                 do not ask for confirmation
```

### gash logs scan

```text
Report the log files eating disk, grouped by category

Usage:
  gash logs scan [PATH...] [flags]

Flags:
      --depth int           limit how deep each root is walked (0: no limit)
  -h, --help                help for scan
      --json                one JSON object on stdout
      --min-size string     ignore files smaller than this (e.g. 1M, 512K)
      --older-than string   ignore files modified more recently than this (e.g. 7d, 48h)
```
